data.long_meaning: Ikshita means 'desired, longed for, wished for' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'iksh' which means 'to see' or 'to desire'. The name symbolizes intelligence, vision, and prosperity. The name Ikshita carries the meaning “Intelligence, Vision, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ikshita usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligence, vision, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
